Problem_Opportunity: Inactive shower outlets may discharge or drip after outlet selection or shutdown.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Commercial diverters, transfer valves and integral check valves.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Materially reduce unwanted discharge from inactive outlets without extra user action.
Proposed_Product_Response: Pressure-driven shuttle isolation stage integrated into multi-outlet manifold/diverter.
Evidence_Source: Reddit user reports; Bath Royale; Kohler K-11748; ROSS shuttle valve; Lexair shuttle valve
Main_Uncertainty: Existing check-valve architectures already target the same outcome; no measured advantage established.
Quality_Gate_Reason: Existing-solution check and meaningful delta not demonstrated.

Problem_Opportunity: Automatic shower inlet-screen cleaning triggered by fouling.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Commercial differential-pressure self-cleaning filters; prior 2026-09-21 Claw candidate.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Transfer automatic hydraulic/backwash cleaning into a compact shower inlet screen.
User_Benefit: Reduced manual filter cleaning if technically feasible.
Main_Uncertainty: Shower pressure/flow, water loss, noise, hygiene, scale/debris behavior and package remain unresolved.
Quality_Gate_Reason: Duplicate / saturated variant from prior Claw run.

Problem_Opportunity: Residual water remains on spray face after use.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Conventional drain holes, self-draining showerheads and hydrophobic surfaces.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Use directional wettability/capillary routing to move residual droplets toward controlled drain paths.
Proposed_Product_Response: Engineered spray-face surface with wetting gradient and capillary drainage tracks.
User_Benefit: Potentially faster drying without moving parts.
Main_Uncertainty: Soap, scale, cleaners and wear may destroy surface behavior; benefit versus simple drainage is unproven.

Problem_Opportunity: Low-flow showering can fall below tankless-heater activation/operating thresholds.
Existing_Solution_or_Source: Higher shower flow, lower-threshold heater, flow restriction changes, separate shower-start/temperature-control products.
DELTA_or_Transferable_Capability: Maintain stable heater-demand conditions while preserving intended low delivered shower flow without simply increasing total flow.
Proposed_Product_Response: Pressure/flow-responsive internal hydraulic path in mixer/cartridge/flow-control architecture.
User_Benefit: Stable comfortable low-flow showering with less dependence on heater minimum-flow behavior.
Technology_Mechanism: Pressure/flow-responsive hydraulic routing; exact mechanism PROPOSED.
Fitting_Application: Mixer cartridge / flow-control module / integrated shower
Evidence_Source: Noritz; U.S. DOE; field reports; ShowerStart
Main_Uncertainty: Temperature safety, energy loss, pressure loss, topology compatibility, prior art and quantitative benefit.

Problem_Opportunity: Minor scratches and cosmetic degradation affect premium shower/faucet finishes.

Proposed_Product_Response: Bathroom-compatible self-healing polymer/topcoat over suitable substrate/finish.
Fitting_Application: Exposed trim / handshower shell / accessory surface
Main_Uncertainty: Chemical resistance, warm-water healing, hardness, adhesion, appearance and cycle durability.
Quality_Gate_Reason: Transferability and user-value advantage over existing finishes unresolved.
